capabilities.surface: Desktop shell: Tauri 2 core-only boundary
capabilities.limitations: The Windows core-only shell, native folder picker, project-bound persistence, discovery, process, job, artifact and event services compile and pass native tests. Working directories and path-shaped arguments are confined to the canonical project root before enqueue/spawn. Spawned process trees are assigned to a Windows Job Object with fixed taskkill fallback, and real parent/grandchild cancellation passes. An unsigned NSIS development installer is produced; Linux, clean-machine installation and release signing remain unverified. No engineering engine or device permission is enabled by default.

capabilities.surface: Top bar and all workspaces
capabilities.limitations: Browser preview stores one project in transactional localStorage and has no filesystem authority. Desktop project directories use bounded atomic manifest writes; clean-machine and Linux persistence verification remain pending.

capabilities.surface: Mission control: New engineering project
capabilities.limitations: Creates the fixed alpha document shape.

capabilities.surface: Top bar: Import and Export project
capabilities.limitations: JSON and .entcproj projects use bounded schema-aware validation, migration defaults and unknown-field preservation. Browser mode has no directory authority; desktop directory persistence is project-scoped and verified on Windows.

capabilities.surface: Project model: archive entry safety boundary
capabilities.limitations: The browser imports and exports a deterministic, store-only .entcproj ZIP containing the canonical manifest, with strict entry count, header, size, CRC and UTF-8 validation. Directory attachments and generated artifacts are not embedded in this manifest-only profile.

capabilities.surface: Top bar: theme toggle
capabilities.limitations: Stored inside project settings rather than user preferences.

capabilities.surface: Top bar and Ctrl+K
capabilities.limitations: Navigation commands only; focus management is incomplete.

capabilities.surface: Circuit Lab palette, canvas and inspector
capabilities.limitations: Pin-to-pin aliases, persistent orthogonal routing with up to 64 ordered bend points, pointer and keyboard bend editing, graphical junction/net-label movement, and pin-level ERC highlighting are built in. Copy/paste remaps internal nodes and offsets preserved routes; component deletion prunes orphan aliases. Rendered screen-reader and browser input-latency qualification remain open, while selection history is runtime-only.

capabilities.surface: Canonical project model and future engine adapters
capabilities.limitations: Represents named component terminals plus bounded junction and net-label metadata deterministically; arbitrary graphical pin routing remains limited.

capabilities.surface: Circuit Lab: Export SPICE
capabilities.limitations: Exports a deterministic subset for passive elements, independent DC/current sources and diode/LED models; it does not execute SPICE or claim ngspice compatibility for unsupported devices.

capabilities.surface: Canonical schematic validation
capabilities.limitations: Checks the canonical component graph, grounded topology, duplicate references, source conflicts, numeric values and required n1/n2 pin presence. Diagnostics resolve through wire aliases to exact canvas pins, expose accessible invalid state and focus their source. Electrical pin-direction classes and advanced mixed-signal drive-conflict rules are not implemented.

capabilities.surface: Circuit Lab: SI engineering-value parsing
capabilities.limitations: Recognizes the supported SI/unit vocabulary; unit conversion beyond scalar prefixes is not implemented.

capabilities.surface: Circuit Lab: Grid
capabilities.limitations: Snapping offers fixed 10/20/40-pixel presets; arbitrary spacing and per-document unit scaling are not implemented.

capabilities.surface: Circuit Lab: Fit and zoom controls
capabilities.limitations: Pan/zoom is a browser-canvas viewport transform; minimap and persisted viewport preferences are not implemented.

capabilities.surface: Circuit Lab: Run DC analysis
capabilities.limitations: Nonlinear operating point for resistors, capacitors (open), inductors (short), exponential diode/LED models sized from the rated forward voltage, ideal switches and independent sources, with canonical wire/net-label aliases. No controlled sources, diode breakdown or temperature model; dense solver limited to 400 unknowns.

capabilities.surface: Circuit Lab: NPN/PNP, N/P-MOSFET and op-amp parts
capabilities.limitations: Ebers-Moll BJT (Is = 10 fA, BR = 1) with constant CJE = 8 pF, CJC = 4 pF and TF = 0.3 ns but no voltage-dependent depletion capacitance, Early effect, reverse transit time (storage delay) or terminal resistances; SPICE level-1 MOSFET with lambda = 0.01, body tied to source and constant Cgs = 10 pF, Cgd = 2 pF instead of Meyer charges; capacitances are fixed per device type. Op-amp with 200k open-loop gain, one pole for 1 MHz GBW, symmetric smooth clipping at ±value, zero output resistance and no slew-rate limit.

capabilities.surface: Digital Logic Lab: Boolean & K-map
capabilities.limitations: Up to 8 variables; K-maps are drawn for 2 to 4 variables. The minimum cover is exact up to 40 candidate prime implicants and greedy (flagged) beyond that. Universal NAND/NOR forms are two-level realizations, not multi-level optimized.

capabilities.surface: Digital Logic Lab: Logic simulator and number codes
capabilities.limitations: Text netlists of up to 500 gates and D/T/JK flip-flops with a fixed 1 ns delay, rising-edge clocks and active-high asynchronous reset; no graphical schematic entry, buses, tri-states or setup/hold checks. Truth-table extraction supports up to 8 inputs of combinational circuits. Codes cover unsigned values up to 32 bits.

capabilities.surface: Communication: analog and digital modulation tabs
capabilities.limitations: Single-tone analog modulation with ideal analytic-signal receivers (no receiver noise or filters); digital links use ideal symbol-rate AWGN with perfect synchronization; theoretical BER for 8-PSK and 16-QAM is the nearest-neighbour approximation; eye diagrams are polar baseband without a matched filter.

capabilities.surface: Communication: sampling, PCM, line codes and error-control coding tabs
capabilities.limitations: Sine-wave PCM with mid-rise uniform or μ-law (μ = 255) quantization; line codes up to 64 bits; Hamming codes up to 57 data bits; CRC is MSB-first long division with zero initial value and no reflection; convolutional coding is the rate-1/2 K = 3 (7, 5) code with hard-decision Viterbi only.

capabilities.surface: Signals & DSP: filter designer and convolution tabs
capabilities.limitations: Butterworth and Chebyshev type I IIR up to order 12 via the prewarped bilinear transform (no elliptic, Bessel or Chebyshev II); FIR by the windowed-sinc method up to 513 taps (no Parks-McClellan); coefficients are double precision without fixed-point quantization; convolution explorer limited to 64-sample sequences.

capabilities.surface: Control: transfer function, root locus/Routh and PID tabs
capabilities.limitations: Continuous-time SISO rational transfer functions up to degree 20 without transport delay; time responses need a proper system; root locus samples gains on a logarithmic grid; Ziegler-Nichols uses the ultimate-gain method only; the PID derivative uses a first-order filter.

capabilities.surface: RF & Antennas: Smith chart, matching, transmission line, antenna array and link budget tabs
capabilities.limitations: Lossless lumped L-networks and ideal stubs at a single frequency; microstrip uses quasi-static Hammerstad-Jensen without dispersion, thickness or conductor loss; antenna arrays are uniform, collinear and ignore mutual coupling; link budgets are free-space Friis without terrain, multipath or rain models.

capabilities.surface: Engineering Calculators module
capabilities.limitations: Ideal formulas: 555 thresholds at exactly 1/3 and 2/3 Vcc, op-amps with a single-pole GBW and rail-to-rail output, E48/E96 values generated by rounding (E192 not included), capacitor codes cover the common three-digit EIA marking only.

capabilities.surface: Microcontroller Lab: 8051 assembler, simulator, trainer board and serial terminal
capabilities.limitations: 8051/8052-style core with 128 B direct + 256 B indirect RAM, timers 0/1 and UART; no timer 2, power-down/idle modes or on-chip variants (e.g. AT89S52 watchdog). UART TI timing follows the datasheet (start of stop bit) and differs from ucsim by under 1 %. The LCD model ignores controller busy time; keypad and switches have no bounce.

capabilities.surface: Microcontroller Lab: Arduino Uno (ATmega328P) simulator
capabilities.limitations: Runs compiled Intel HEX only (sketches are compiled in the Arduino IDE/CLI, not in the browser). Instruction results and cycle counts match simavr; interrupt entry follows the datasheet. Timer output-compare pins (PWM, CTC toggle) drive D3/D5/D6/D9/D10/D11 with datasheet timing. Timer input capture, watchdog reset, analog comparator, sleep-mode power behaviour and self-programming are not modelled; SPI slaves other than a 74HC595 read 0xFF; the I²C bus models a PCF8574 LCD backpack and a DS1307 RTC only. Browser speed is roughly half of real time.

capabilities.surface: Microcontroller Lab: logic analyser with UART, SPI and I²C decoders and VCD import/export
capabilities.limitations: Captures the simulated boards only (no USB logic-analyser hardware). Peripheral waveforms (TXD, SCK/MOSI/MISO, SCL/SDA) are drawn from the hardware events at ideal timing, without rise times or clock stretching. Each channel keeps the latest 40 000 edges. Decoder output matches sigrok-cli 0.7.2 for the tested framings; 10-bit I²C addresses and 9-bit UART frames with parity are not decoded.

capabilities.surface: Lab Bench: oscilloscope, function generator, CV/CC bench supply and multimeter on the Circuit Lab circuit
capabilities.limitations: Instruments read the built-in transient solver (fixed time step, at most 20 000 points per capture), so very fast edges at long time/div settings are under-sampled. Probes are ideal (no 1 MΩ/10 pF loading) and channels are referenced to ground; the generator drives one voltage source and the supply up to two. CC mode is decided at the DC operating point. The multimeter measures resistance with every source switched off and has no input-impedance loading.

capabilities.surface: Lab Records: practical-journal PDF with circuit, bench captures, simulations and programs
capabilities.limitations: Uses the 14 standard PDF fonts without embedding (Helvetica, Courier, Symbol), so text is limited to WinAnsi Latin characters plus Greek and common maths symbols from Symbol; other scripts (e.g. Devanagari) print as '?'. No images or circuit-diagram drawing: the circuit is listed as a component table. Output was checked with pypdf in strict mode and rendered with Ghostscript.

capabilities.surface: Microcontroller Lab: Arduino Uno co-simulated with the Circuit Lab circuit
capabilities.limitations: Arduino Uno only (not the 8051). Pins are modelled as a 25 Ω driver, a 35 kΩ pull-up or a 1 GΩ input with fixed 1.5 V / 3.0 V Schmitt thresholds; there is no supply-rail loading, clamp diodes or pin current limit. The circuit is advanced at every connected-pin edge and at least every chosen time step (10–200 µs), so circuit dynamics faster than that step are smoothed. Combined speed is roughly 0.4–0.5× real time in a browser.

capabilities.surface: Power Electronics: rectifiers, DC-DC converters, inverters and AC voltage controller
capabilities.limitations: Ideal switches and diodes (no forward drop, reverse recovery or switching loss), no source/leakage inductance (instant commutation, no overlap angle), ideal transformer-less supplies. Inverter load currents are the steady-state harmonic response of a series R-L load (no dead time). DC-DC converters have no ESR, no snubbers and an ideal PWM. Values agree with the textbook formulas; a DCM buck matches ngspice 42 within 0.03 %.

capabilities.surface: ADC & DAC Lab: transfer function, DNL/INL, SNR/ENOB, SAR, flash, dual-slope, sigma-delta and R-2R / weighted DACs
capabilities.limitations: Behavioural models: comparators are ideal apart from the chosen offset/mismatch, there is no aperture jitter, settling, kickback or reference loading, and DACs have ideal switches and an ideal op-amp (only resistor tolerance is modelled). Sigma-delta modulators are 1-bit, 1st/2nd order without integrator scaling or limits; their SQNR is a few dB below the linear-model formula, as for real 1-bit loops.

capabilities.surface: Sensors & Instrumentation: thermocouples, RTDs, thermistors, bridges, LVDT and measurement chains
capabilities.limitations: Thermocouple types E, J, K, N and T only (NIST ITS-90 reference functions, matched to the NIST tables within 1 µV); no lead-wire, self-heating or thermal-lag effects. In-amp models are ideal apart from the E96 gain resistor (no offset, CMRR, noise or bandwidth). The measurement chain assumes an ideal ADC and reference.

capabilities.surface: EV Engineering: battery pack, road load and range, motor and acceleration, charging
capabilities.limitations: Steady-state and lumped models: constant cell voltage and resistance (no SoC or temperature dependence), constant drivetrain efficiency, ideal torque–speed envelope, no drive cycles, and a linear CC-CV taper. Cell presets are typical values, not specific products.

capabilities.surface: FPGA & Digital: built-in Verilog simulator with console and waveforms
capabilities.limitations: A Verilog-2001 subset for teaching: no SystemVerilog, generate blocks, gate primitives, UDPs, inout/tri-state resolution of multiple drivers, real numbers, $readmemh/file I/O, specify blocks or `define macros (compiler directives are ignored). One time unit = 1 ns regardless of `timescale. $display output and all waveforms match Icarus Verilog 12 on 21 test designs, including its time-zero ordering.

capabilities.surface: VLSI Lab: CMOS inverter VTC, noise margins, delay and power
capabilities.limitations: SPICE level-1 square-law devices with channel-length modulation only: no velocity saturation, body effect, subthreshold leakage, short-channel effects or device capacitances (the load is a single lumped capacitor). Agrees with ngspice 42 level-1 within 1 mV on the VTC and 0.5 ps on the delays for the default process.

capabilities.surface: RTOS Scheduler: RM, DM, EDF, LLF, FCFS, round robin, resource protocols and response-time analysis
capabilities.limitations: Uniprocessor, integer ticks, zero context-switch and scheduling overhead, periodic tasks only (no aperiodic servers or jitter), at most 5000 ticks and 8 tasks in the UI. Resource protocols model single-unit resources with non-nested critical sections.

capabilities.surface: Network Theory: phasor MNA, Thévenin/Norton, superposition, maximum power, star–delta, two-port parameters
capabilities.limitations: Linear lumped circuits at one frequency (or DC): R, L, C, independent V/I sources and the four linear dependent sources; no mutual inductance, ideal transformers or op-amp macro-models. Phasors are RMS. Node voltages match ngspice 42 .ac to 6 significant digits.

capabilities.surface: Signals & Systems: Fourier series, Laplace and z-transform partial fractions, DFT and FFT butterflies
capabilities.limitations: Fourier series for six standard waveforms (no arbitrary expressions). Transforms take rational functions as coefficient lists; repeated poles are detected with a relative tolerance of 1e-5 and polished, so near-coincident distinct poles may merge. Partial fractions match scipy.signal.residue/residuez on the test cases. The step-by-step DFT is limited to 32 samples and the butterfly view to 16.

capabilities.surface: EM & Microwave: point charges and Gauss's law, plane waves and skin depth, Fresnel and polarisation, rectangular/circular waveguides, two-port S-parameter cascades, amplifier stability
capabilities.limitations: Electrostatics of point charges only (no conductors, dielectrics or boundary-value solving); field map is the z = 0 plane. Plane waves are uniform and media linear, isotropic and homogeneous; Fresnel assumes non-magnetic media with real refractive indices. Waveguide modes are ideal (TE10 wall loss only, no dielectric loss); circular-guide modes use tabulated Bessel zeros up to n = 3, m = 3. Two-port networks use a single real reference impedance; stubs and lines are TEM with an optional uniform loss. Cascades, Z/ABCD conversions, TE10 loss, Rollett K and MAG match scikit-rf 2.1.

capabilities.surface: Communication: superheterodyne frequency plan and image rejection, Friis cascade noise figure, sensitivity, cascaded IIP3 and SFDR; optical-fibre NA, V-number, power and rise-time budgets
capabilities.limitations: Planning formulas, not a signal-level receiver simulation: image rejection assumes one single-tuned preselector, noise is referred to 290 K and IIP3 cascades assume coherent worst-case addition. Fibre calculations use step or parabolic graded index, the V²/2 mode estimate and the rise-time (sum of squares) method; no PMD, nonlinear effects or optical amplifiers.

capabilities.surface: Cellular Planning: Erlang-B/C traffic, hexagonal reuse with S/I and sectoring, Okumura–Hata/COST-231 path loss and cell radius, handoff with shadowing
capabilities.limitations: Classic planning models only: Erlang B/C assume Poisson arrivals and exponential holding; S/I counts the first tier of co-channel cells; Hata is a median-loss empirical model valid for 150–2000 MHz, 1–20 km, base 30–200 m. The handoff study is a single straight road between two cells with Gudmundson-correlated log-normal shadowing (seeded), no fast fading or network signalling. Erlang-B values match published tables to 1e-3 E.

capabilities.surface: Computer Networks: IPv4 subnetting, VLSM, summarisation and IPv6 notation; Dijkstra and distance-vector routing with count-to-infinity; stop-and-wait/Go-Back-N/Selective Repeat timelines; ALOHA and CSMA throughput
capabilities.limitations: Teaching models, not a packet simulator: routing graphs are undirected with symmetric costs and distance vector runs in synchronous rounds; ARQ timelines assume a fixed propagation delay, no processing time, a single sender and losses chosen by transmission number. MAC throughput curves are the classic analytic results (Poisson offered load). Subnet results match Python's ipaddress module and Dijkstra matches scipy.sparse.csgraph.

capabilities.surface: Cryptography: Caesar/Vigenère/Playfair/Hill/rail fence with cryptanalysis, extended Euclid, square-and-multiply, Miller–Rabin, CRT, RSA, Diffie–Hellman with MITM, AES/DES/SHA-256 round by round, HMAC
capabilities.limitations: For learning, not for protecting data: implementations are not constant-time, RSA is textbook (no OAEP/PSS padding) and key generation is seeded and reproducible. Miller–Rabin is deterministic below 3.3e24 and probabilistic above. Baby-step giant-step is limited to p < 1e12. AES matches FIPS 197 and node:crypto (ECB/CBC, 128/192/256), DES matches the classic worked example and PyCryptodome, SHA-256 and HMAC match node:crypto.

capabilities.surface: Sensor Networks: seeded deployments, radio connectivity and hop counts, 1- and k-coverage, first-order radio energy model and lifetime of direct, minimum-energy multi-hop and LEACH
capabilities.limitations: Round-based model with Heinzelman's first-order radio (no MAC collisions, retransmissions, idle listening or sleep scheduling); one packet per node per round, perfect aggregation at cluster heads, unit-disc radio and sensing ranges, coverage estimated on a grid. Results reproduce the published trends (LEACH extends first-node death several times over direct transmission with a distant sink) rather than exact figures.

capabilities.surface: SDR Flowgraph: drag-and-drop block editor with sources, math, FIR filters, resampling, mixer, FM and PSK/QAM modulation with RRC pulses, channel model, scope, FFT, constellation, measurement and symbol-error sinks
capabilities.limitations: Offline batch processing of one buffer (up to 131072 samples) in topological order — no streaming, feedback loops, hardware sources or audio output, and no carrier/timing recovery (symbol timing is a fixed sample offset). FIR outputs match scipy firwin + lfilter; FM round trips and QPSK symbol error rates match theory.

capabilities.surface: Image Processing: test images and uploads, histograms and point operations, Otsu, spatial/median filters with noise, Sobel/Prewitt and Canny, 2-D FFT filters, binary morphology with object counting, JPEG-style DCT compression
capabilities.limitations: Greyscale only, at 128 × 128 pixels (uploads are converted with BT.601 luma and resized by nearest neighbour). Frequency filters need power-of-two sizes. JPEG compression stops before entropy coding, so the size estimate is the fraction of non-zero quantised coefficients. Convolution, Sobel, median, erosion/dilation, labels and DCT match scipy; Otsu and PSNR match scikit-image.

capabilities.surface: Biomedical Signals: synthetic or pasted ECG with zero-phase cleaning, Pan–Tompkins QRS detection, HRV (SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50, Poincaré, LF/HF) and EEG band powers
capabilities.limitations: Synthetic ECG is a Gaussian-wave model, not a physiological simulator; EEG is a sum of band-limited sinusoids. Pan–Tompkins finds every beat in the synthetic tests and agrees with a consensus of three NeuroKit2 detectors on 93 % of beats (count within 2) in the first minute of MIT-BIH record 208, an arrhythmic record where the reference detectors also disagree; MIT-BIH annotations could not be downloaded here, so it has not been scored against cardiologist labels. Welch PSD matches scipy.signal.welch. For learning only, not for diagnosis.

capabilities.surface: Neural Networks: MLP playground on six 2-D datasets (decision regions per epoch, loss/accuracy curves, weight diagram) and the perceptron learning rule on logic gates
capabilities.limitations: Small fully connected networks only (up to four hidden layers of 32), trained synchronously in the browser on at most 400 points; no convolutional or recurrent layers, GPUs or model export. Backpropagation is verified by finite-difference gradient checks to 1e-6.

capabilities.surface: Math Console: MATLAB-style scripts and command line with complex scalars, real matrices, A\b, ranges, user functions, engineering suffixes, maths/linear-algebra/polynomial/circuit functions and plot()
capabilities.limitations: Its own interpreter (no eval): no loops, if/else, cell arrays, strings beyond literals, or complex-valued matrices; matrices are dense and meant for small systems. Linear algebra, statistics and polynomial results match NumPy on the test expressions.

capabilities.surface: Learning Hub: six tracks of 36 lessons linked to the labs, quizzes with seeded numeric and multiple-choice questions, viva practice with self-marking, and the verified lab checkpoints
capabilities.limitations: Short lessons, not a full textbook; quizzes check numeric answers to a relative tolerance (2 % unless stated) and accept engineering notation but not expressions. Progress is stored in the project file, not in an account. Selected answers are cross-checked against the cellular, receiver, waveguide and link-budget engines.

capabilities.surface: AI lab partner: chat panel on every page using any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, Ollama, OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini), with tools backed by the Math Console, the MNA circuit solver, the current lab's inputs and the Learning Hub
capabilities.limitations: Needs the user's own API key or a local Ollama server; nothing is sent until the user enables it and agrees to share. The model is instructed to compute every number with the built-in tools and each reply shows the tool calls it made, but language models can still misread a question or ignore an instruction — the shown calculations are the checkable part. Settings and the key are stored only in browser localStorage, never in project files. Tested against a mock OpenAI-compatible server; no live provider is contacted in CI.

capabilities.surface: Information & Coding: entropy, Huffman and Shannon–Fano codes with reduction tables, LZW, mutual information and channel capacity (Blahut–Arimoto, Shannon–Hartley), m-sequences and Gold codes, DSSS with a tone jammer, FHSS hop patterns and an OFDM link with cyclic prefix and multipath
capabilities.limitations: Binary codes only (no ternary Huffman, arithmetic or adaptive coding); LZW uses fixed-width codes with an unbounded dictionary seeded from the message's own alphabet. Channel capacity is for discrete memoryless channels and the band-limited AWGN formula. DSSS and FHSS are baseband BPSK models with ideal chip and hop synchronisation; the jammer is a single tone. OFDM uses real channel taps, perfect channel knowledge and a zero-forcing one-tap equaliser, without coding, pilots, synchronisation or PAPR handling. Huffman optimality, PN run/autocorrelation properties, Gold three-valued cross-correlation and BPSK BER are checked against closed-form results in the tests.

capabilities.surface: Analog Design: design-to-specification for voltage-divider BJT bias and CE amplifiers (with one-click open in Circuit Lab), Wien/RC phase-shift/Colpitts/Hartley/crystal oscillators, Butterworth Sallen–Key low/high-pass filters of order 1–10, MFB band-pass, Zener and LM317 regulators, Schmitt triggers and the 565 PLL
capabilities.limitations: Hand-analysis models: BJT bias uses a fixed VBE (0.7 V) and β, small-signal figures ignore ro and the Early effect; the Circuit Lab check uses the built-in Ebers–Moll model and lands within a few per cent. Filters and oscillator feedback networks are verified with the phasor MNA solver and an ideal op-amp (VCVS gain 10⁷), so slew rate, GBW and output limits are not modelled; only Butterworth alignments are generated. LC oscillators ignore transistor loading and mutual inductance; the PLL uses the NE565 data-sheet formulas. Regulator designs are steady-state (no ripple rejection or transient response).

capabilities.surface: Measurements: virtual AC bridges with a live null detector and a hidden-unknown challenge mode (Maxwell, Hay, Owen, Schering, De Sauty, Wien), Lissajous figures, reading statistics and limiting-error propagation, voltmeter loading, ammeter shunt / Ayrton shunt / voltmeter multiplier / series ohmmeter design and the Q-meter
capabilities.limitations: Bridges use ideal components, an ideal source and an infinite-impedance detector (no stray capacitance, Wagner earth or detector loading). Lissajous figures assume pure sinusoids and identify ratios with denominators up to 12. Error propagation is first order; the Q-meter correction uses the double-frequency method for distributed capacitance. Every bridge result is computed from the general complex balance and checked against the textbook closed forms in the tests.

capabilities.surface: Radar & Satellite: radar range equation with pulse integration, pulse timing, Doppler, MTI canceller and blind speeds, FMCW ranging; Kepler orbits, GEO look angles and uplink/downlink budgets with G/T; thin-dipole patterns with numerical directivity and beamwidth, dish/horn gain and Friis; reflex klystron modes, two-cavity bunching, magnetron Hull cut-off, directional coupler and VSWR
capabilities.limitations: Radar uses the free-space monostatic equation (no clutter, multipath, atmospheric attenuation or Swerling fluctuation; integration is ideal coherent). Orbits are two-body Keplerian with a spherical Earth; look angles are for geostationary satellites. Dipole patterns assume a sinusoidal current on a thin wire; aperture gains use a fixed efficiency. Tube formulas are the small-signal textbook (Liao) relations. Directivity of λ/2, short and full-wave dipoles, GEO radius and period, and the radar/link equations are checked against reference values in the tests.

capabilities.surface: Speech Processing: microphone recording, WAV loading or synthetic vowels; short-time energy, zero-crossing rate and voiced/unvoiced/silence labels; pitch by autocorrelation, AMDF and cepstrum with a pitch track; LPC by Levinson–Durbin with formants from the polynomial roots and LPC/cepstral envelopes; spectrogram and MFCCs
capabilities.limitations: Audio is resampled to 8 kHz mono by simple averaging and kept only in memory (it is not saved into project files); at most 10 s is analysed. The voiced/unvoiced rule uses fixed energy and zero-crossing thresholds. Formants come from a single analysis frame without tracking. No speech recognition or synthesis beyond the source–filter vowel model. MFCCs match python_speech_features 0.6 frame for frame; LPC satisfies the Toeplitz normal equations; formants and pitch of synthetic vowels are recovered within a few per cent.

capabilities.surface: PLC & Automation: a text ladder language (series/parallel contacts, normally closed and rising-edge contacts, coils, set/reset, TON/TOF/TP timers, CTU/CTD counters, RES) drawn as a ladder diagram with live power flow, a live scan-cycle run with clickable inputs and output lamps, scripted timing diagrams and industrial examples (seal-in, interlock, traffic light, star–delta, counter, alarm)
capabilities.limitations: A teaching subset of IEC 61131-3 ladder: Boolean bits I/Q/M 0.0–7.7, 16 timers and 16 counters; no analog I/O, math, compare or move blocks, subroutines, function blocks, structured text or SCADA/HMI and fieldbus. Timers count in whole scans of a fixed simulated scan time. Live mode runs in the browser at 10 scans per 100 ms tick; the scan semantics (top-to-bottom solve, results visible to later rungs, edge memory per scan) are checked in the tests.

capabilities.surface: Circuit Lab: Run transient
capabilities.limitations: Fixed-step trapezoidal integration (backward Euler on the first step) limited to 20,000 points; one independent source follows a step, sine, square-pulse or constant stimulus while the others stay at DC. Switches keep their authored state; no adaptive time step, breakpoints or diode junction capacitance.

capabilities.surface: Circuit Lab: Run AC sweep
capabilities.limitations: Small-signal sweep linearized at the DC operating point with a 1 V or 1 A input on one source; logarithmic sweep limited to 1,000 points. No noise, distortion or pole-zero analysis.

capabilities.surface: Circuit Lab: generated signal preview
capabilities.limitations: Generated preview only; it is not an oscilloscope or simulation waveform.

capabilities.surface: Embedded Lab source editor
capabilities.limitations: Plain textarea with local persistence; compiler diagnostics appear only after a detected, permissioned Arduino CLI compile.

capabilities.surface: Embedded Lab: Structure check
capabilities.limitations: Checks setup(), loop() and brace balance only; it does not compile C++.

capabilities.surface: Embedded Lab inventory, compile, upload and device controls
capabilities.limitations: Read-only installed board/core/library inventory, explicit target selection, compilation/upload and a separately permissioned bounded serial terminal are implemented for desktop projects. Inventory does not discover attached devices or install packages. This host has no Arduino CLI or hardware execution evidence, so real compile, upload and serial I/O remain unverified.

capabilities.surface: PCB Studio: board layout, autorouting, DRC and fabrication export
capabilities.limitations: Two-layer boards with rectangular outlines and parts on the top side; a fixed footprint library for the Circuit Lab part types; grid A* autorouting without copper pours, differential pairs or length tuning; no KiCad import/export. Gerber/Excellon output parses in gerbonara but has not been fabricated.

capabilities.surface: PCB: fabrication artifact manifest and checklist
capabilities.limitations: Records and validates bounded KiCad artifact metadata and hashes; KiCad execution and artifact generation remain unverified.

capabilities.surface: HDL: VCD digital waveform import
capabilities.limitations: Bounded scalar and vector VCD parsing is wired to pasted input and verified generated-artifact readback. No installed GHDL/Verilator waveform run or advanced grouped/cursor waveform viewer is claimed on this host.

capabilities.surface: HDL: versioned source-set, constraint and target document
capabilities.limitations: Validates bounded authored HDL metadata and separates simulation, synthesis and place-route job definitions; native engine execution, waveform generation and device implementation remain unverified.

capabilities.surface: Verilator HDL adapter contract
capabilities.limitations: The desktop UI can materialize bounded authored SystemVerilog under a project run, execute source-linked lint through the project-scoped runner, retain evidence and cancel the owned process. The hardware-free HDL smoke fixture has a real Verilator lint pass; desktop-shell invocation and compiled simulation remain unverified.

capabilities.surface: GHDL VHDL adapter contract
capabilities.limitations: The desktop UI can execute separate analyze, elaborate and simulate jobs in an isolated project run, request a bounded VCD, register and integrity-check it, and parse it locally. No installed GHDL run is claimed on this host.

capabilities.surface: FPGA & Digital
capabilities.limitations: Authored SystemVerilog/VHDL plus separately cancellable lint, simulation, synthesis and place/route workflows are wired behind exact desktop detection and process/artifact grants.
